description: Baseline molecular Delta-Sternheimer RPA prescription for an isolated molecule in a box.

box_size.per_system_override_rule: Converge the vacuum box so periodic images do not interact; a molecule needs far more vacuum than a solid.
box_size.rationale: Too small a box changes the correlation energy through image interaction.

nfreq.rationale: The RPA correlation energy integral converges slowly in frequency.

grid_cutoff.per_system_override_rule: Keep the response real-space grid consistent with the ABACUS ecutwfc.
grid_cutoff.rationale: The response grid must match the mean-field grid.

pca_threshold.per_system_override_rule: Loosen the PCA threshold for molecular auxiliary bases, which are small and well conditioned.
pca_threshold.rationale: A tight threshold on a small molecular auxiliary basis is expensive without accuracy gain.

occupied_basis.per_system_override_rule: Choose the occupied basis per molecule; a molecule's occupied manifold is system-dependent.
occupied_basis.rationale: The occupied basis depends on the element set, so it is never pinned globally.
